messages.subject: Action Required: Wells Fargo 2025 Summer Internship - Investment Banking (San Francisco) | Preference Form
messages.body:
Good afternoon,

We hope this email finds you well. Thank you for applying to the Wells Fargo 2025 Summer Investment Banking Internship Program (San Francisco).

To remain in the process and indicate your group preference, you will need to complete the below group preference form. Please complete it by noon EST on Monday, April 8.

[Preference survey link]

Abey T. Dessie, Recruiter - Early Careers, Corporate and Investment Banking
messages.note: toRecipients is EMPTY - Jon is a bcc recipient. A product that attributes mail by To/Cc match would not connect this message to Jon at all. It also carries a hard deadline ('Action Required', complete by noon Monday).

messages.body:

messages.subject: Wells Fargo: First Round Investment Banking Interview Invitation (San Francisco)
messages.body:
Congratulations! You have been selected to receive a first-round interview for the Investment Banking track as part of the Wells Fargo CIB 2025 Summer Analyst internship program. This role is based in San Francisco.

Please let us know your availability for a 30-minute video interview. Available scheduling times are below. We will email you back to confirm a time that works with our schedule with a meeting invite that includes the video-conferencing link. If you have any scheduling constraints, please let us know.

Monday (4/22) - 1:30pm-4:30pm EST
Tuesday (4/23) - 10am-12pm EST; 2pm-6pm EST
Wednesday (4/24) - 10am-6pm EST

Please note, Wells Fargo will only consider candidates who are presently authorized to work for any employer in the United States and who will not require work visa sponsorship from Wells Fargo now or in the future in order to retain their authorization to work in the United States.

Best regards,
Jon

Jon Savicky

Associate
Technology, Media & Telecom Investment Banking

Wells Fargo Corporate & Investment Banking
30 Hudson Yards, 64th Floor | New York, NY 10001
Cell: 203.216.6671 | Office: 332.214.6308

jonathan.savicky@wellsfargo.com<mailto:jonathan.savicky@wellsfargo.com>
